idea-plugin.name: Mario AI Debug Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Investigate bugs using the current editor selection, stack traces, Git changes, and optional Loki logs.

  • Analyze evidence with DeepSeek, OpenAI, Ollama, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
  • Navigate to code referenced in a stack trace and review AI-generated unified diffs before applying them.
  • Keep API credentials in the IDE Password Safe.

AI requests are initiated by the user and require confirmation before code or logs are sent to the configured provider. No account or telemetry service is operated by this plugin.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: AI-assisted bug analysis, optional Loki log context, model discovery, and reviewed patch application.

action.description: Analyze the selected code with AI and Loki logs
